text.text_excerpt: I cannot believe I haven't ever been here before. Ok, ok, ok, we're super neighborhood-oriented here, but this is a bar I'd move uptown for (hehe). We stopped by Madigan's for an afternoon happy hour, and it was just the perfect mix of great jukebox music, delicious cold beers, breeze from the open windows, sounds of the streetcar, and fantastic service. My husband ordered a specialty cocktail (Death in the Afternoon - Champagne and Absinthe) and it was delightfully mixed. The green fairy came out to play as I sipped my Juicfer (lots of local beers on tap!) They've got awesome bar food and a great happy hour. Definitely a neighborhood spot not to miss. Ok, so I went here one Friday night after work for happy hour. Happy hour is until 7 P.M. They offer $4 well drinks and $4 wine. The bartender was super sweet and attentive. I have to say, I was impressed with the food. We ordered potato skins, cheese fries, chicken quesadillas and spinach dip. Everything came out hot. The skins were each a nice size. They were pretty tasty. You get 4 skins in one order. The cheese fries were also a nice sized portion. I would have liked more cheese on the fries, but that's just me. I really enjoyed the chicken quesadilla appetizer. It was tasty. It was also enough to eat as a meal. The spinach dip was some of the best bar dip that I've ever had! Seriousl...

Call Nancy Drew. Call The Hardy Boys. We have a case of another missing review on our hands. Madigan's, I have definitely reviewed you before; I would not have checked in this many times without writing a proper review. Oh well, here we are again. Madigan's is known mainly as a college hang out, and I guess that's true to a certain extent. On weekend nights you will find a younger crowd here, but it doesn't get as crazy as other college bars in the area. As of late, I have been meeting friends here in the late afternoon/early evening for post-work drinks. The bar gets gorgeous light at this hour and the big windows allow you to look out on Carrollton Avenue and watch the street cars go by...
